description.value: A full-service, landscaped RV park on Hwy 16 in Prince Rupert, roughly a mile from the BC Ferries terminal for Haida Gwaii and Alaska sailings; tent sites run $30/night with showers included, making it a solid transit stop with city amenities but no natural setting to speak of.
